- [USER] User expressed interest in the evolution of the film industry and notable films of the last decade.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The film industry has evolved from black and white silent films to modern-day blockbusters.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Silent Era spanned from the late 19th century to the late 1920s, characterized by silent films and visual storytelling.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Golden Age of Hollywood lasted from the 1930s to the 1950s, marked by big-budget productions, the introduction of sound and color, and the rise of genres like musicals, westerns, and film noir.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Iconic directors from the Golden Age include Alfred Hitchcock and Frank Capra.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The New Hollywood era occurred in the late 1960s and 1970s, featuring filmmakers like Martin Scorsese, Steven Spielberg, and Francis Ford Coppola.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Notable films from the last decade include:
  - The Social Network (2010) - story of Facebook's creation.
  - La La Land (2016) - a tribute to the Golden Age of Hollywood.
  - Black Panther (2018) - an African-American superhero film.
  - Roma (2018) - a story about a live-in housekeeper in Mexico City.
  - Parasite (2019) - a South Korean black comedy thriller about two families from different socioeconomic backgrounds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The film industry is exploring new frontiers, breaking traditional forms, and enabling diverse creators to share their voices.
